advisoryCouncil.title: University Staff Advisor
advisoryCouncil.name: Staff Advisor — Uva Wellassa University
advisoryCouncil.institution: Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka
advisoryCouncil.scope: Provides strategic counsel on university policy adherence, academic faculty liaison, student development ethics, and campus governance integration.

advisoryCouncil.title: Leo Club Advisor (Guiding Lion)
advisoryCouncil.name: Club Advisor — Lions Club of Badulla
advisoryCouncil.institution: Lions Club of Badulla • Leo District 306 C2
advisoryCouncil.scope: Ensures adherence to the Lions Clubs International Constitution, mentors club officers on youth leadership stewardship, and coordinates district funding pipelines.

president.name: Leo Club President
president.responsibilities: Presides over all executive and general assemblies, directs overall strategic vision, represents UWU Leos at District 306 C2 conventions, and stewards inter-faculty service initiatives.
president.motto: “Leading with passion, serving with purpose for Uva Wellassa and beyond.”

excoOfficers.name: Leo Vice President
excoOfficers.scope: Directs project directorate coordination, supervises internal operational logistics, and represents the president in executive assemblies.

excoOfficers.name: Leo Secretary
excoOfficers.scope: Stewards official records, meeting minutes, monthly district activity reporting via Lion Portal / MyLCI, and inter-club correspondence.

excoOfficers.name: Leo Treasurer
excoOfficers.scope: Manages treasury accounts, oversees project funding allocations, financial auditing, and ensures fiscal accountability to Lions District 306 C2.

excoOfficers.name: Leo Assistant Secretary
excoOfficers.faculty: Faculty of Animal Science & Export Agriculture
excoOfficers.scope: Maintains official membership rolls, secretarial dispatch logistics, meeting attendance verification, and circular distribution.

directors.name: Director of Community Services
directors.scope: Coordinates rural welfare missions, humanitarian relief distribution in Passara and Badulla, and emergency community support.

directors.name: Director of Education & STEM
directors.scope: Directs Project Sipnana, rural school book distribution campaigns, science laboratory workshops, and youth scholarship initiatives.

directors.name: Director of Environmental Conservation
directors.faculty: Faculty of Animal Science & Export Agriculture
directors.scope: Oversees Central Highlands reforestation, eco-trail cleanups across Ella/Dunhinda, and campus sustainability drives.

directors.name: Director of Health & Wellbeing
directors.scope: Leads the Annual Mega Blood Donation campaign with Badulla Teaching Hospital, health screening clinics, and first-aid workshops.

directors.name: Director of Public Relations
directors.scope: Manages official club branding, press releases, social media channels, event photography, and publication design.

directors.name: Director of Information Technology
directors.scope: Develops and maintains the official club digital portal, cloud directories, digital publishing pipelines, and tech operations.

directors.name: Director of Member Development
directors.scope: Orchestrates undergraduate member onboarding, annual induction assemblies, leadership bootcamps, and fellowship outings.

directors.name: Director of International Relations
directors.scope: Facilitates twinning programs with global Leo clubs, Multiple District 306 youth conferences, and international humanitarian exchanges.

governance.title: Constitution & Standard Leo Club By-Laws
governance.description: Operating under the official Charter of Lions Clubs International, sponsored by the Lions Club of Badulla within Leo District 306 C2, Sri Lanka.
